calculation.description: Cross-sectional median demeaned 20-trading-day momentum, directionally inverted during positive lagged five-day benchmark-yield shock z-scores. All conditioning uses information available before the signal date.

validation.regime_notes: Passes benchmark admission gates on 138 recent dates with the full 15-instrument cross-section. Earlier dates were unavailable after conditioning because the required yield histories were not simultaneously valid; interpret as recent-regime evidence rather than full-history robustness.
